text:
Anya P.: Quick triage — 0.7.0 is live. Seeing a small cluster of regressions. Need to decide: which items go into a hotfix vs 0.7.1 vs backlog. TL;DR: 2 P0-ish, 3 P1, rest enhancements.
Mike R.: tracking board -> https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-1234 (lists repro steps + sample orgs)
Devon H.: which are the P0s? can we defer non-customer-facing stuff?
Anya P.: P0s: 1) streaming fallback sometimes drops the last message (customer-facing chat flows). 2) embeddings service timeout -> 500s for some orgs on long inputs. Both are high customer impact.
Leah G.: UX impact note on streaming fallback: when it drops users lose context. Strongly recommend hotfix for streaming.
Mike R.: +1 on streaming hotfix. Embeds timeout sounds infra-heavy — might be a config/regression and could be fixed in 0.7.1 if we can do a targeted mitigation.
release-bot: Deploy window available: today 18:00 UTC. Patch branch: refs/heads/patch/0.7.1. Runbook link: https://confluence.example/release/runbooks/0.7.1
Anya P.: :thumbsup: Proposal: hotfix for streaming fallback today, embed timeout targeted for 0.7.1 (canary first). Non-customer UX tweaks -> backlog.
Devon H.: SRE can own the embed timeout mitigation. I can investigate root cause and a temporary throttling guard. ETA for first findings: EOD.
Mike R.: I can implement a streaming guard and add extra unit/integration checks. Rollout plan: hotfix streaming -> immediate canary (5%) -> ramp if green. Embed fix in 0.7.1 with canary 5% for 1h then 100%.
Anya P.: Acceptance criteria (for tickets): streaming fallback: no dropped messages in synthetic suite for 30m + no customer reports in canary orgs; embed timeout: 99.9% success rate in canary for 1h. If we can't meet these, rollback and re-evaluate.
Leah G.: Small design request: preserve timestamp order on retry. Not blocking — backlog for 0.7.2 unless it affects streaming UX.
Mike R.: Action items: @Devon H. -> heap/flame + mitigation, @Mike R. -> streaming guard and test, @Anya P. -> notify affected customers + status page update.
Devon H.: Ill run sampling today and post findings in RED-1234. If it's a config leak between services, I can hotpatch a throttle.
Anya P.: Locking scope now: hotfix = streaming fallback fix + status update. 0.7.1 = embed timeout fix + tests. Backlog = minor UX polish. Ill update the release ticket and the roadmap line.
Mike R.: Patch branch steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/0.7.1
# cherry-pick streaming fix commit
git push origin patch/0.7.1
```
Mike R.: @Devon H. can you confirm you have access to the patch branch when youre ready? :eyes:
Devon H.: confirmed. Ill push a debug artifact to the patch branch if needed.
Anya P.: Thanks team. If we hit any blockers, escalate to the on-call list and well decide rollback vs patch.
Mike R.: :white_check_mark: moving cards and assigning owners now.
release-bot: Incident/Status update draft created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2024-0007 (Anya P. to publish)
